messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.Name: Community Bug-Fix Collection
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.Description: This mod contains fixes for various small Resonite Issues that are still open.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.AnyProtocolHyp: Allows Hyperlink components to open URLs with any scheme, not just http(s).
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.BetterGridWorl: Improves the Grid World Preset by preventing the shaking ground and centering the grid.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.BetterListEdit: Improves the list editors in inspectors, preventing an exception while adding elements and renaming them when they're moved around.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.BreakDragAndDr: Break Drives of Drag'n'Drop Copied Components
Fixes copying components using drag-and-drop breaking drives.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.CaseInsensitiv: Makes picking custom generic type parameters case-insensitive.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ColorDisplayVa: Fixes ValueDisplay<color> not having a ValueProxySource component.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ColorXNodeName: Fixes ProtoFlux node names containing ColorX being spaced wrong.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ConsistentCont: Makes the context menu stay a fixed on-screen size in desktop mode, regardless of FOV.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ConstantNodeNa: (Legacy) Changes the names of the ProtoFlux nodes in Strings > Constants to what they were with the original fix.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.CopySyncMember: Adds Copy to Clipboard action on any non-reference member fields in inspectors.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.CorrectMateria: Fixes the MaterialGizmo being scaled twice when using Edit on the Material Tool.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.CorrectOverrid: Corrects the spelling of Overridden on ProtoFlux nodes.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.DuplicateAndMo: Duplicate and Move Multiple Grabbed Items
Fixes references between multiple duplicated or transferred-between-worlds items breaking.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.FadeContextMen: Makes the outlines of the labels of the context menu fade out like the rest of it.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.FixMigratedIte: Fixes migrated items sent as messages not spawning because they still point to the old platform.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.FlipAtUserView: Fixes FlipAtUser component by using the view position as reference instead of the head slot position.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.GammaCorrected: Fixes ColorX Luminance calculations being incorrect for non-linear color profiles.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.GroupCloudHome: Uses the User Cloud Home template instead of the missing Group template.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.HighlightHomeW: Fixes the selected Home World in the Inventory not being highlighted as a favorite.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ImportMultiple: Fixes it not being possible to import multiple audio clips at once.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ImportWebFiles: Fixes URLs to text files or Resonite Packages failing to import instead of appearing as a hyperlink.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.LocalizedByteF: Localizes the storage units (MiB, GiB, etc.), in particular for the StorageUsageStatus component. There's an option to use IEC format (factor 1024) over decimal (factor 1000).
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.LongerWorldLoa: Only lets the World Load Progress Indicator disappear after 20s or more if the process failed.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.MemberEditorUp: Sets the Update Order of MemberEditor components in inspectors to the highest value to (most of the time) prevent a frame delay in the value they show.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NaNtEqual.Name: NaN't Equal
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NaNtEqual.Desc: Makes NaN floats / doubles never equal to each other for the ProtoFlux == and != nodes, as well as the ValueEqualityDriver component.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NoAudioOutputC: Prevents the AudioOutput component from updating listeners when it's been removed and crashing the sessions.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NoLossOfColorP: Fixes Color Profile not being preserved on all operations.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NodeNameAdjust: Fixes the confusing names of the Remap [-1; 1] to [0; 1] ProtoFlux nodes.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NoFunForCorpor:
Prevents April Fools related content from triggering when the user is in a Universe.
This is overridden by the Force April Fools setting, which forces this content to be active.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NonHDRColorCla: Fixes non-HDR variants of Color(X) channel addition not clamping.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NonLinearColor: Forces colorX From HexCode to use the sRGB rather than Linear profile.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.NoParentUnderS: Prevents the ChildParentAudioClipPlayer components from crashing the game if their ParentUnder field is set to the slot that it's on. Also adds a header text explaining the problem.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.PauseAnimatorU: Fixes animators updating all associated fields every frame while enabled but not playing.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ReallyNoDestro: Makes the NoDestroyUndo component actually prevent undoing destroying something.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.TriggerDashScr: Re-runs the CleanupOldComponents method of the RadiantDashScreen components in Userspace.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.SmoothDraggabl: Workaround for Sliders and Joints snapping in sessions hosted by a headless.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.StationaryGrab: Stops the Grab World Locomotion from moving the player with each activiation.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.SteamVRFocusRe: Prevents the SteamVR Unity plugin from permanently lowering the render resolution when a focus event is missed.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.StopTrackedDev: Adds null-checks in the TrackedDevicePositioner component's UpdateBodyNode method to prevent log spam.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.TiltedUIAlignm: Tilts the UI-Focus camera to work around UIX rendering issues.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ValidQuaternio: Makes the ProtoFlux Tool spawn valid float and double quaternion inputs.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ValueModDecima: Adds a zero check to the Decimal ValueMod ProtoFlux node to prevent DIV/0 crashes.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.Config.Options: Contains the settings for the few fixes that offer them.
Whether to force April Fools content to be active. Requires No Fun for Corporate to be enabled.
Whether to format bytes using IEC (factor 1024) as opposed to decimal format (factor 1000) when Localized Byte Formatting is enabled.
messages.CommunityBugFixCollection.ChildParentAud: This AudioClipPlayer component's ParentUnder field must never be set to the slot it's on. Otherwise, the game will crash when a clip is triggered.
